report.summary: The report's sourcing is unusually clean: every tagged sentence's embedded specifics — the 44,28,000 shares at ₹10, the FY2018 revenue of ₹60.53 crore and profit of ₹3.15 crore, the five-year revenue/PAT/EBITDA/total-asset/borrowing series, the 52% and 57% customer concentrations, the ₹1,130 lakhs working-capital object, ₹405.02 lakhs of demand loans, the 74,95,476 shares and 90.949% promoter stake, the 28/26-year-old CFO and CS, the ₹68.4/₹57.7/₹324.3 lakh related-party figures, and the 2016 struck-off dates — matches the cited page excerpts, including the reverse-chronological column order on the restated financials. Derived comparative statements (e.g., FY2018 EBITDA being the second-highest while revenue is the lowest, and the ₹36.70 crore long-plus-short borrowing total) are arithmetic on figures already tagged to the same pages, so no uncited company-specific fact remains. No unsupported or wrong-source citations were found; blocking_count is zero.
